mapper.select: /** [sql-sql-consignedMaterialsReq.xml] ConsignedMaterialsReqMapper.getConsignedMaterialsReqSearch **/ SELECT MF15.MF15_COMPANY , MF15.MF15_FACTORY , MF15.MF15_NO , TO_CHAR(MF15.MF15_INDTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MF15_DAT , TO_CHAR(MF15.MF15_INDTE, 'HH24:MI') AS MF15_TIME , MF15.MF15_SEQ , MF15.MF15_CUS , CM01.CM01_NAME AS MF15_CUS_NAME , MF15.MF15_INDTE , MF15.MF15_EMPNO FROM TB_MF_15 MF15 INNER JOIN TB_CM_01 CM01 ON MF15.MF15_COMPANY = CM01.CM01_COMPANY AND MF15.MF15_FACTORY = CM01.CM01_FACTORY AND MF15.MF15_CUS = CM01.CM01_CODE WHERE MF15.MF15_COMPANY = #{mf15Company} AND MF15.MF15_FACTORY = #{mf15Factory} ORDER BY MF15.MF15_NO, MF15.MF15_DAT, MF15.MF15_CUS
